whoWeAre.title: A specialist exporter, built on long-term partnerships
whoWeAre.intro: We bring automotive product knowledge, supplier coordination, and export experience together for businesses that need a dependable source in India.

sections.title: Built for business supply
sections.body: Our work is focused on wholesale and export requirements. We coordinate sourcing, order details, quality checks, packing, and shipment documentation so buyers can manage procurement with one experienced partner.

sections.title: A broad automotive range
sections.body: We source genuine, OEM, and aftermarket spare parts for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger vehicles, and heavy commercial vehicles. Our wider product range also includes lubricants, tyres, and batteries.

sections.title: A growing export operation
sections.body: Bajrang began in Delhi in 2009 and has grown from a 100-square-metre starting space into a 165,000-square-foot warehouse operation. Today, our team serves business customers across more than 50 countries.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: Clear communication and dependable business practices at every stage.

values.title: Quality focus
values.body: Careful attention to product specifications, inspection, and export packing.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: Responsive coordination from enquiry and quotation through dispatch.

values.title: Partnership
values.body: Long-term relationships built around each buyer’s sourcing needs.

about.intro: Bajrang Auto Parts Pvt. Ltd. is an India-based export partner for importers, wholesalers, distributors, and automotive trading businesses. We make it easier to source a broad range of vehicle parts and related products from India.

recognitions.title: Recognitions and certifications
recognitions.intro: Our registrations, memberships, and quality credentials reflect our commitment to responsible export operations and consistent service.

items.title: Star Export House
items.body: Recognized by the Government of India in 2018 for export performance.

items.title: Authorised Economic Operator (AEO T-1)
items.body: Accredited by Indian Customs under the World Customs Organization SAFE Framework, supporting secure and efficient trade processes.

items.title: ISO 9001:2015
items.body: Quality management system certification issued by International Accreditation Service (IAS).

items.title: FIEO Associate Member
items.body: Member of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations.

items.title: MSME Registered
items.body: Registered as a Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise in India.

items.title: Indian Industries Association
items.body: Member of the Indian Industries Association (IIA).

items.title: Registered Intellectual Property
items.body: Bajrang’s brand identity and logo are registered intellectual property.

items.title: Industry Feature
items.body: Featured by Aftermarket magazine, published by Infomedia.

hardWorkship.title: Care in every step of the supply chain
hardWorkship.intro: Reliable export supply is built through consistent work: sourcing the right products, checking order details, protecting parts in transit, and keeping buyers informed.

steps.title: Sourcing
steps.body: We coordinate across product categories and supplier networks to match business requirements.

steps.title: Order coordination
steps.body: Our team confirms specifications, quantities, availability, and shipment expectations.

steps.title: Quality checks
steps.body: Orders receive careful checks against the agreed product and packing details.

steps.title: Export packing
steps.body: Products are prepared for international transport with attention to protection and handling.

steps.title: Dispatch support
steps.body: We coordinate dispatch and export documentation and keep customers updated.

contact.title: Talk to our export team
contact.intro: Share your parts list, target brands, quantities, or destination market. Our team will help with your wholesale sourcing enquiry.
